checkpoint.authentication: dedicated checkpoint signing credential under deployment root

coordinated_rollback.limitation: No selected external checkpoint exists. A coordinated rollback of DB + issuer lifecycle/key store + CHA store is not currently detectable. coordinated_rollback.availability: fail closed pending independently authenticated operator reconciliation

trust_root.rotation_revocation: signed successor with monotonic generation; retain history; revoked never reactivated

reconciliation.query: issuer read-only authoritative registry query over mutually authenticated channel
binding: canonical evidence bytes or immutable reference
reconciliation.restart: retrieve by immutable evidence id from retained history

attempt_transactions.A_initial_reservation: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; insert immutable reservation and current fenced pointer atomically
attempt_transactions.B_immutable_finalization: insert final attempt and CAS pointer on reservation id/fence in one transaction
attempt_transactions.C_replacement_switch: insert replacement reservation/evidence relation then CAS old pointer/fence to new in one transaction
attempt_transactions.D_local_recovery: append authenticated resolution reference and CAS pointer; never infer UNBOUND from NOT_FOUND
